manifest.counterTiming: ProfilerRecorder.LastValue is the completed preceding frame; wall interval uses Stopwatch timestamps. CSV frame labels the preceding frame.
manifest.input: UIDocument NavigationSubmitEvent callbacks, repeated attempts; no physical touch or hardware input claim.
manifest.workload: 5s warm,10s idle walk,20s seeded continuous spin/manual purchase,5s ready final quest,10s completed walk,10s portrait resize360x640 then540x1080.

notes: Development Mono/D3D11 Player, target60 vSync0. Oldv0.3 Player and idle Editor remain open in both measurements.
Stopwatch intervals are end-to-end frame intervals; they include scheduling, limiter waits and instrumentation.
ProfilerRecorder.LastValue labels completed preceding frame. Custom markers include whole methods; nested durations overlap.
UIDocument NavigationSubmitEvent exercises real button callbacks; additional guard snapshots add allocations on action frames.
Uninstrumented Release performance, physical touch, thermal endurance and Android performance are not measured.
A zero-only or absent metric is reported unavailable rather than fabricated. Resize contains real swapchain/layout transients.
